assertions.name: wire_up_safe_for_tritium
assertions.source: Every catalogue.lookup_derived for (atom-braid-T, λ, T) must exactly match pyhecke_native.chi_q_via_gp for all λ ⊢ 9. If all match, the wire-up pattern is safe to roll out to closed_form_tau_M.py and the per-atom mass-table sweep.

description: Phase 3 production wire-up demo. For every λ ⊢ 9 in the Tritium catalogue, verifies `catalogue.lookup_derived` returns the same q-Laurent as a direct `pyhecke_native.chi_q_via_gp` call. If all pass, the wire-up pattern is safe to roll out to `closed_form_tau_M.py` and the per-atom mass-table sweep.

data.interpretation: 30/30 cells match direct compute; wire-up speedup 1189.1× (catalogue replaces 0.18s of GP reduction with 0.15ms of dict lookups). Production sites can now adopt the lookup_derived pattern with confidence.
